tickets.title: Decide tenancy, authorization, and runtime contracts
tickets.delivery: Settle the access and deployment contract before tenant-owned workflows are implemented.

tickets.title: Decide source connections, capture, and freshness
tickets.delivery: Define how projects acquire trustworthy GA4, GSC, and page evidence.

tickets.title: Decide signup measurement and evaluation rules
tickets.delivery: Make conversion reports and evaluation outcomes independently reproducible before implementing them.

tickets.title: Decide AI execution, credential, and usage policies
tickets.delivery: Freeze the provider and execution rules needed for predictable owner-key-or-app-key AI access.

tickets.title: Decide context retention and recommendation lifecycle
tickets.delivery: Define how project knowledge stays explainable and how recommendation decisions evolve.

tickets.title: Add the isolated Playwright authentication journey
tickets.delivery: Run a real authenticated browser journey locally and in a manual GitHub Actions workflow using the adapted Fakturax pattern.

tickets.title: Create and switch tenant-owned website projects
tickets.delivery: Let owners create website projects and authorized users select them, with explicit superadmin access and isolation.

tickets.title: Edit versioned project goals and business briefs
tickets.delivery: Configure each website's goals, audience, offering, and constraints while retaining historical versions.

tickets.title: Select pages and supply manual page content
tickets.delivery: Let users choose analysis pages and provide durable content for inaccessible pages.

tickets.title: Connect GA4 and inspect goal evidence
tickets.delivery: Connect a project's GA4 property and display source-backed goal evidence with identifiable counting semantics.

tickets.title: Connect GSC and inspect search evidence
tickets.delivery: Connect a project's Search Console site and display trustworthy search-performance evidence.

tickets.title: Discover and capture public website pages
tickets.delivery: Discover selectable public pages and retain their content as analysis evidence.

tickets.title: Manage owner credentials and project AI defaults
tickets.delivery: Let the team owner manage their AI key in account settings while projects configure provider/model defaults.

tickets.title: Run a queued OpenAI analysis and inspect recommendations
tickets.delivery: Start a background analysis of selected manual page evidence and receive several actionable recommendation cards.

tickets.title: Verify analysis with a real worker and shared business clock
tickets.delivery: Exercise pending-to-completed analysis through actual queue workers without borrowing browser session or prior-job context.

tickets.title: Run the shared analysis workflow through Anthropic
tickets.delivery: Switch providers and produce equivalent recommendation records without resetting project context.

tickets.title: Recover sources and analyze useful partial evidence
tickets.delivery: Make source failures and stale/missing evidence visible while allowing supported partial analysis.

tickets.title: Track recommendation decisions and implementation intent
tickets.delivery: Let users plan, postpone, dismiss, and inspect recommendations with durable decisions.

tickets.title: Record independent and grouped implemented changes
tickets.delivery: Record what actually went live, when, and which zero, one, or several recommendations it implements.

tickets.title: Calculate reproducible before-and-after results
tickets.delivery: Evaluate recorded changes against a configured goal and show measurements, outcomes, and uncertainty.

tickets.title: Pass selected reports or evaluations to AI
tickets.delivery: Request and retain an AI interpretation beside the exact measured data the user selected.

tickets.title: Resume project work through history and rebuilt context
tickets.delivery: Make prior ideas, decisions, changes, results, reviews, and next steps usable across sessions and providers.

tickets.title: Display AI usage and enforce operational allowances
tickets.delivery: Show consumption and safely pause further analyses or AI reviews when configured allowances are exhausted.

tickets.title: Schedule scoped analyses with usage controls
tickets.delivery: Let owners enable per-project schedules and run due analyses through the same workflow as manual work.

tickets.title: Recover failed runs without duplicate product records
tickets.delivery: Provide understandable retries and meaningful attempt history while preserving earlier successful work.

tickets.title: Resume project setup and show analysis readiness
tickets.delivery: Offer a persisted checklist that guides project setup without demanding every optional source.

tickets.title: Complete the project overview and navigation
tickets.delivery: Open projects on a useful overview that connects measurements, issues, recommendations, active evaluations, and analysis.

tickets.title: Validate Fakturax and a second independent website
tickets.delivery: Prove the agreed complete improvement loop works through ordinary configuration on more than one website.
